coverageSummary: This plan covers the SB360 React Native mobile application's navigation shell, resilience/error-handling, bilingual (English/Arabic) localization with RTL/LTR mirroring, secure/local storage, centralized API client, audit/telemetry, and repository/environment hygiene. Foundation tasks establish the app skeleton, centralized API client, secure/local storage, i18n/RTL engine, auth/session handling, and audit emission module that all story slices build on. Story tasks map 1:1 to all 25 user stories (US-001–US-025), each delivering the full vertical slice (UI + state + API integration) needed to satisfy its linked AC-* rows. The backend API itself (navigation config, i18n, profile, section content, health endpoints) is treated as a pre-existing external system per Dependencies §2 Assumption 1 — only client-side integration/consumption is in scope.
uncoveredRequirementIds: Backend API implementation (API-001–API-006 endpoints themselves): out of scope — Dependencies §2 Assumption 1 states backend already exists; this plan covers client consumption only.

phases.name: Foundation — platform scaffold and shared infrastructure
exitCriteria: Done when the React Native/TypeScript app skeleton, navigation module boundaries, and Redux store are written to disk under Code/frontend/
Done when the centralized API client module, secure/local storage modules, i18n/RTL engine, auth/session module, and audit emission module source files exist under Code/frontend/src/
Done when environment-based configuration files and .gitignore rules excluding secrets/build artifacts are in place

phases.name: User stories — vertical slices
exitCriteria: Done when every US-001 through US-025 has at least one implementation slice whose source files satisfy its mapped AC-* rows
Done when all story tasks depend on the relevant foundation task(s), ensuring no story code references unbuilt shared modules

tasks.title: Create app skeleton, navigation module boundaries, and Redux store

acceptanceCriteria: AC-021: Done when Code/frontend/ directory tree, .gitignore (excluding build artifacts/secrets), and root App/store files are written to disk
tasks.taskContext: BR-001/BR-005 require a single cross-platform codebase (React Native + TypeScript, React Navigation, Redux Toolkit per Dependencies §2 Assumption 4). FR-021/AC-021 require the repo to contain no committed build artifacts or secrets. Create the top-level app structure (src/navigation, src/store, src/screens, src/components) with a .gitignore covering node_modules, build output, and env files. Write the project directory layout, package manifest placeholder, root App entry, Redux store setup, and React Navigation container wiring under Code/frontend/.

tasks.title: Build centralized API client module with timeout and error contract
tasks.description: Write src/api/client.ts (Axios instance with 10s timeout, HTTPS enforcement, generic error mapping) and src/config/env.ts reading from environment files for the base URL.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-020: Done when src/api/client.ts is the single exported HTTP client module used for all API-00x calls
AC-022: Done when src/config/env.ts resolves backend base URL from environment variables with no hardcoded host
tasks.taskContext: FR-020/AC-020 require all backend calls to route through one centralized Axios-based client (NFR-MAINT-001: swap-without-refactor abstraction). FR-022/AC-022 require the backend base URL to be driven by environment configuration (react-native-config) with no code changes needed to switch environments. NFR-PERF-003/Dependencies Assumption 3 fix the client-side request timeout at 10,000 ms for all calls; NFR-SEC-001 requires transport encryption (HTTPS only) and NFR-SEC-006 requires generic, non-leaking error messages surfaced from failures. Write src/api/client.ts (Axios instance with 10s timeout, HTTPS enforcement, generic error mapping) and src/config/env.ts reading from environment files for the base URL.

tasks.title: Implement local and secure storage modules
tasks.description: Write src/storage/secureStorage.ts (Keychain-backed) and src/storage/localStorage.ts (AsyncStorage-backed) with typed get/set APIs.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-024: Done when src/storage/secureStorage.ts and src/storage/localStorage.ts are written with segregated APIs for PII/tokens vs. non-sensitive data
tasks.taskContext: FR-024/AC-024 and NFR-SEC-003 require PII (email, displayName) and auth tokens to be stored only in secure storage (react-native-keychain), while non-sensitive data (last-selected language, last-active tab, cached nav config per Dependencies §1) uses AsyncStorage. NFR-SEC-004 requires PII to never be written to logs. Two distinct storage adapters must be exposed with clear boundaries so feature code cannot accidentally mix sensitive and non-sensitive data. Write src/storage/secureStorage.ts (Keychain-backed) and src/storage/localStorage.ts (AsyncStorage-backed) with typed get/set APIs.

tasks.title: Build i18n and RTL/LTR layout direction engine
tasks.description: Write src/i18n/index.ts (i18next config + en/ar resource bundles) and src/i18n/useDirection.ts (RTL/LTR context hook).
acceptanceCriteria: AC-010: Done when src/i18n/index.ts loads en/ar bundles and exposes a translation hook with no hardcoded strings remaining in shared components
AC-015: Done when src/i18n/useDirection.ts exposes a layout-direction value derived from the active locale
tasks.taskContext: FR-010/AC-010 and FR-025/AC-025 require all user-facing strings (including navigation labels) to be sourced from i18next/react-i18next resource bundles, with no hardcoded strings. FR-015/AC-015 and NFR-ACC-001 require layout direction (RTL for Arabic, LTR for English) to mirror atomically using react-native-localize and I18nManager. This module provides the translation hook, locale resource bundles (en, ar), and a layout-direction context consumed by all screens. Write src/i18n/index.ts (i18next config + en/ar resource bundles) and src/i18n/useDirection.ts (RTL/LTR context hook).

tasks.title: Implement auth/session module with reset-on-failure handling
tasks.description: Write src/auth/sessionManager.ts (token attach interceptor + reset-on-401 handler) built on the F2 client.
acceptanceCriteria: NFR-SEC-007: Done when src/auth/sessionManager.ts clears stored tokens and session state on any 401 response from the API client
tasks.taskContext: Dependencies §2 Assumption 2 states authenticated endpoints (API-003 language preference, API-004 profile) use Bearer JWT. NFR-SEC-007 requires the session to be reset (tokens cleared, user returned to an unauthenticated state) whenever authentication fails on a protected call. This module attaches the Bearer token to outgoing requests via the F2 API client and listens for 401 responses to trigger a session reset. Write src/auth/sessionManager.ts (token attach interceptor + reset-on-401 handler) built on the F2 client.

tasks.title: Build audit event emission module (PII-free)
tasks.description: Write src/audit/auditEmitter.ts with a typed event schema and PII-field stripping guard.
acceptanceCriteria: AC-023: Done when src/audit/auditEmitter.ts exposes emitAuditEvent() and strips/rejects any PII-shaped keys before emission
tasks.taskContext: FR-023/AC-023 require an audit event to be emitted for every state transition (navigation tab change, language change, retry, error, invalid-transition-reject) without including PII, per NFR-SEC-004. This module exposes a single emitAuditEvent(eventType, metadata) function that strips any PII-shaped fields before dispatching to the telemetry sink (vendor TBD per Dependencies §1, so this emits to a local event bus/console sink as a placeholder). Write src/audit/auditEmitter.ts with a typed event schema and PII-field stripping guard.

The bar must render even while config is loading (skeleton/placeholder state) to avoid a blank screen (ties to NFR-REL-001). Write src/navigation/BottomNavBar.tsx rendering nav items fetched via the F2 API client, mounted at the root navigator level so it persists across all primary screens.

Write src/navigation/navConfigService.ts to fetch config via F2 client on startup, cache it via F3 localStorage, and fall back to the cached copy on failure.

acceptanceCriteria: AC-006: Done when any navigation/screen load failure renders ErrorState.tsx with a generic localized message instead of a blank screen

Write src/components/ErrorState.tsx and wire it into navConfigService.ts (S05) and screen loaders to render on fetch failure instead of an empty view.

acceptanceCriteria: AC-007: Done when tapping Retry re-invokes the failed navigation/screen call and succeeds when the backend responds
NFR-REL-003: Done when repeated rapid Retry taps are throttled to a minimum interval

Add a Retry button to ErrorState.tsx (S06) that re-invokes the original failed service call with a throttle guard (e.g., debounce/min-interval), emitting an audit event via auditEmitter.

FR-023: Done when a rejected invalid transition emits an audit event via auditEmitter
tasks.taskContext: FR-009/AC-009 require invalid navigation transitions (e.g., tapping a tab while config is malformed, or a route not in the resolved nav config) to be rejected silently without breaking the UI, with an audit event emitted via F6 (NFR-SEC-005 client-side input validation). Add a guard in navigationActions.ts (S02) validating the target route against the current nav config before calling navigate(), rejecting and emitting an audit event on mismatch.

Write src/profile/languageSyncQueue.ts that queues a failed languagePreferenceService (S12) sync attempt and retries it on network-reconnect events.

tasks.description: Audit and refactor navConfigService.ts (S05), languagePreferenceService.ts (S12), and ProfileScreen.tsx (S17) to confirm all backend calls route through the single F2 client export.
